name: Chromite Bridge
description: Drive a client-side AI-commerce agent loop against local chromite-server (gateway turns + zero-trust commerce RPCs) for Telegram DMs and /chromite commands. Also handles seller-only /confirm command for manual payment confirmation.

chromiteUrl.description: chromite-server base URL. Falls back to env CHROMITE_BRIDGE_URL.

maxReplyChars.description: Truncate final reply (Telegram 4096-char hard limit minus margin).

requestTimeoutMs.description: Max ms to keep SSE connection alive before aborting.

interactionRuntimeMode.description: Interaction projection runtime. Default local-b3 preserves the current Telegram mock button path; chromite-b1 redeems backend operation_token through chromite.

sellerTelegramUserIds.description: DEPRECATED (rbac-v1): seller authz moved to chromite users.role; no longer consumed by /confirm. Kept for config backward-compat; safe to remove.
